title: Olla-DFT: a command-line toolkit for Quantum ESPRESSO
description:
Olla-DFT prepares Quantum ESPRESSO inputs, analyzes material properties and organizes results with provenance. It includes an offline interactive explorer with SVG, PNG, CSV, JSON and HTML export, and checkpoint-based recovery for supported pw.x jobs.

Version 1.3.0 adopts AGPL-3.0-or-later for the project-owned software and includes the full license and a versioned source link in interactive HTML exports. Commercial use is permitted under the license. Earlier releases retain their original GPL terms; third-party components and existing scientific examples retain their declared licenses. No scientific algorithms or numerical results changed.

Visual gallery: bilingual PDFs, figures and source conditions. Explore the examples and the 1.2.0 demo.

Recovery evidence remains three local matched pairs (SCF, relax, vc-relax), one pair per case, with simulated process interruptions. Physical power loss, VM replacement and cloud savings remain unmeasured. Benchmark and archived evidence.

Author / Autor: Jorge Enrique González Sevilla. License scope / Alcance de la licencia.
